<!-- pr-reviewer: 8a8716d016c60d6a2640108ba686b5752466f3c3 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Trial merge with current origin/main (incl. #275 #277 #279 #280 #282 #285): clean, no conflicts. No build.rs, scripts, `.github/` or dependency changes.

**What looks good**
- Layering holds: the UI reads only through `MeshCache::classify`/`viewed_classes` and `app::machined_classes`; no `sys_*` or world calls in `ui`.
- Classes are computed once per mesh (`classify` returns early when cached; a second `prime` reuses the same `Arc`, pinned by test). STL export does not pay for them. Nothing per frame except the projection of one triangle.
- Hover (`State::hover_mesh`) is view state, not a command, and is cleared on each hover refresh. That fits the ephemeral-state rule.
- No verdict, no paint: NaN/inf reading, non-finite tolerance, no target, or an unpackable lattice give class 3 (unjudged), never clean. If the class length does not match the facet count, `vertex_classes` returns empty (material look), not clean.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in non-test code; provenance line on the new module; decision record included; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #25`; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit.
- Snapshots: no snapshot files changed; no committed `*.diff.png` / `*.new.png`.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` (incl. machined_classes) | 88 passed |
| app `stock_export` | 2 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib machined` (CWD crates/ui; machined_tests) | 3 passed |
| ui `gpu_render machined_mesh_paints_as_stock` | 1 passed |
| clippy `-D warnings`, camcraft-app (all targets) | clean |
| clippy `-D warnings`, camcraft-ui (CWD crates/ui, all targets) | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `shell.rs`, `interact.rs`, `state.rs` were already far over ~400 lines and grow by a few lines each.
- The PR says it is not hand-tested in the GUI; the highlight colour and legend mapping are worth a quick look by eye.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
